faqs.a: The CDAA is rated 2.5 gpm or 10 L/min in series 1, which screws into a T-13A cavity. A larger series carries more flow, so check the pressure drop at your flow on the performance curve before you choose it.

faqs.q: Which seal materials and body finishes does the Sun Hydraulics CDAA back-to-back check / shuttle valve come with?
faqs.a: Seal options on the CDAA are N = Buna-N, V = Viton. Body options: /AP = Stainless Steel, Passivated. The seal is chosen by a letter near the end of the model code, as in CDAABBN, so state the fluid when you order.

faqs.q: Which cavity does the Sun Hydraulics CDAA back-to-back check / shuttle valve fit?
faqs.a: The CDAA screws into the T-13A cavity for series 1, machined to Sun's drawing for that series. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly.

faqs.q: Which seal kit fits the Sun Hydraulics CDAA back-to-back check / shuttle valve?
faqs.a: Sun supplies a seal kit for every series of the CDAA. Listed kits: series 1, Buna: 990010007, Polyurethane: 990010002, Viton: 990010006. Only the external seals are serviceable; fitting a different external seal does not make the valve compatible with a new fluid.

faqs.q: How is the Sun Hydraulics CDAA back-to-back check / shuttle valve installed?
faqs.a: Screw the CDAA into its T-13A cavity and tighten to 30 - 35 lbf ft (41 - 47 Nm) on a 7/8 in. (22,2 mm) hex. Do not over-torque, and keep the cavity clean and free of burrs.

faqs.q: Where is the Sun Hydraulics CDAA back-to-back check / shuttle valve used?
faqs.a: The CDAA is used for load-sensing and pilot circuits where the signal must not leak away between strokes. Other cartridges for the same circuits are on the [check, shuttle & directional cartridges](/c/cartridge-check-shuttle-valves) shelf.

faqs.q: Sun Hydraulics CDAA or CDAC, CDAD: what is the difference?
faqs.a: The CDAA is the signal external version, rated 2.5 gpm or 10 L/min, while the [CDAC, CDAD](/p/sun-hydraulics-back-back-check-shuttle-valve-signal-at-port-2) is the signal at port 2 version. Choose on the function you need, then check the other page for its flow and cavity before you swap one for the other.
